acceptance_criteria.criterion: Neuer Nutzer kann sich registrieren und wird automatisch Owner eines neuen Tenants
Fehlerhafte Anmeldeversuche geben keine Enumerationshinweise preis

review_findings.summary: Login response time leaks email existence: 74ms (existing+wrong pw) vs 11ms (nonexistent) -- reliable existence oracle despite identical error messages.
getClientIp() prefers client-supplied x-forwarded-for over cf-connecting-ip -- fully spoofable behind Cloudflare, defeats IP-scoped limiting.
Check-then-act (SELECT count, then INSERT) is not atomic -- parallel requests can all pass.
signUp() and create_tenant_with_owner() are separate transactions -- an RPC failure (e.g. slug taken) leaves an orphaned auth user with no tenant and no recovery path.
Whole flow depends on auth.email.enable_confirmations=false; with confirmations on (expected prod posture) no tenant is ever created.
Successful attempts count toward the same limit and the email key is attacker-supplied -- any third party can lock a known victim's email out of login.
No test proves rate-limiter/generic-error is actually wired into the server actions; E2E suite not in CI.
apps/web uses a raw pg Pool with the postgres superuser connection string (SUPABASE_DB_URL) for audit writes -- outside RLS, in the request path.
countAttempts() fails open on DB error; justification (GoTrue's own throttling) doesn't hold for server-action calls.
Any authenticated user can call create_tenant_with_owner unboundedly via PostgREST directly -- no per-user cap.
New login/register/account pages have no axe test despite an established pattern in the repo.

residual_risks: Failed logins for tenantless/unknown emails aren't in audit_logs (documented tradeoff, acceptable given NOT NULL tenant_id).
auth_rate_limit_attempts has no pruning job -- unbounded growth.
recordFailedLoginAttempt attributes the event to the victim as actorUserId -- misleading semantics.
audit pg Pool won't work on Cloudflare Workers (acknowledged, deployment-blocking later not now).
config.toml minimum_password_length=6 vs the app's 12-char rule -- direct GoTrue signups weaker than the app path.
required_actions: Fix client IP resolution to prefer cf-connecting-ip / a trusted XFF hop -- blocking.
Address the login timing oracle or get explicit re-scoping of the AC -- blocking.
Handle or explicitly document/ticket the enable_confirmations=true production path.
Stop counting successful attempts toward the limit; mitigate third-party email lockout.
Add action-level tests for rate-limit enforcement and identical login error strings; decide E2E-in-CI status.
Replace superuser SUPABASE_DB_URL usage in the request path with a least-privilege path.
